label: preparing
what: A secret surprise jubilee for the mayor's forty years of service, planned for day 1 at 18:00 in the great hall, involving eight lanterns and two hundred fresh loaves. Innkeeper, freight, builder, and baker knowingly prepared it; the secretary knowingly helped arrange and escort the mayor while keeping the celebration confidential. The mayor was invited under the cover of a routine hospitality/town meeting and was not told the real purpose in advance.
